title: The one-slot rule in both spec deltas and the G3 item 33 note is attributed to ADR 0005 decision 2, though the owner did not state it and it is the author's reading in design D2
resolution: Both deltas and the item 33 note cite the account pool contract section 7.1, which now says that it applies decision 2 as a one-slot limit because Taskelith cannot check accounts; the ADR amendment is unchanged.

title: The harness delta dropped "any number of slots MAY be added per harness" from the requirement
resolution: Restored as "a harness MAY have any number of slots", with the mechanism clause shortened to keep the body at 495 characters.

title: The candidates criterion says API-billed endpoints are not a goal and then that the amendment puts the API key first, a contradiction
resolution: The sentence now reads "are not a goal, except for Claude Code, where ADR 0005 decision 2 as amended on 2026-10-27 puts the user's own API key first".

title: ADR 0005's status and Risks still say the provider terms are not verified, beside the amendment that rests on the terms recheck
resolution: Both carry a dated note that the Claude Code terms were reviewed on 2026-10-25 and rechecked on 2026-10-27 and that decision 2 was amended accordingly; other harnesses keep their text.

title: The ADR says "no rotation to another account" while the G3 plan and the qualification say "no rotation", and the record claims the same content in each
resolution: The G3 plan D15 and the qualification now use "with no rotation to another account", and the verification claim names the shared wording.

title: Section 7.1 says a rotation never moves the slot to another account without saying that Taskelith cannot check this either
resolution: The sentence adds "which Taskelith cannot check either".

title: The ADR 0008 note says each task is admitted to a stage of that run, which is wrong for delegated child tasks that run in a child run
resolution: The note now says "of its run, the card's run or a delegated child run".

title: Item 45 puts "Not yet planned" in the Depends on column, which names G3 items
resolution: The column now reads "0 (planning pending)", consistent with the rule that every unmerged item depends on item 0.

title: The Git workspace list order is tested by the conformance suite and stated in the contract but not in the git-workspace-port spec
resolution: Out of scope; follow-up spec delta for the list order

title: Scenario Second Claude Code slot ends with "no rotation across Claude accounts can arise", which is untestable and goes beyond section 7.1
resolution: The THEN ends at "the configuration is rejected".

title: The remaining alternative provider path still says authenticated only through a subscription, without the API key of the amendment
resolution: The bullet adds "or, since 2026-10-27, the user's own API key" with a link to G3 item 45.

title: The Credential scope row does not name the one Claude Code slot of the amendment
resolution: The row adds the one slot for "the owner's own account" since 2026-10-27, linking the account pool contract section 7.1.

title: The dependency paragraph lists items that depend only on item 0 without item 45
resolution: The paragraph names items 26, 27, 43, and 45 and says item 45 is in no wave until it is planned.

title: Section 7.1 and the item 12 and 19 notes use "the owner's own account" without a definition and mix the operator and the owner
resolution: The phrase is quoted as the decision's words; section 7.1 says the operator adds the one slot for the account that the decision allows and leaves its mapping to a trust model role to a further owner decision, as design D2 records.

title: The amendment says other harnesses are unchanged, though the decision concerns Claude subscriptions, not only the Claude Code harness
resolution: ADR 0005 and the G3 plan D15 say that other harnesses' own subscriptions are unchanged and that a harness admitted later that can use a Claude subscription falls under the amendment.
